name: LichtFeld Studio
description: Upstream mirror of MrNeRF's LichtFeld Studio: a native C++23/CUDA workstation for 3D Gaussian Splatting that trains scenes from COLMAP datasets, inspects them in real time, edits Gaussian selections and scene nodes with undo/redo, and exports to PLY, SOG, SPZ, USD, RAD or a standalone HTML viewer. It is where a human operates on splat scenes; agents reach the same surface through a local MCP HTTP server (http://127.0.0.1:45677/mcp) with discovery resources and mutation tools, an embedded Python API (`import lichtfeld as lf`) and a manifest-driven Python plugin system. It must never be the canonical store of scene state: it consumes datasets and checkpoints from disk and hands exports back to the ecosystem. NVIDIA GPU required; Windows binaries via the LichtFeld portal, Linux via source or the docker/ image.

capabilities.label: Train from a COLMAP dataset (CLI / headless)
capabilities.description: `LichtFeld-Studio -d <data-path> -o <output-path> [--headless] [-i iter] [--strategy mcmc|default] [--sh-degree N] [--max-cap N] [--config file] [--init ply] [--import-cameras] [--images dir] [--test-every N] [--timelapse-every N] [--ppisp-sidecar] [--python-script file]`. Headless mode requires --data-path or --resume. Writes checkpoints and PLY snapshots to the output path.
capabilities.side_effects: GPU training job; writes output dir

capabilities.label: Open a PLY/checkpoint in the viewer (-v)
capabilities.description: `LichtFeld-Studio -v <file.ply>` or `--resume <checkpoint>` launches the GUI on an existing scene without training; the app also starts with no arguments as an empty workstation.

capabilities.label: Convert/export a scene from the CLI (-f)
capabilities.description: Export sub-parser: `-f/--format ply|sog|spz|html|usd|usda|usdc|rad [--sog-iterations K] [--sh-degree N]` converts a loaded PLY/checkpoint into the chosen delivery format without the GUI.

capabilities.label: Plugin scaffolding and validation CLI
capabilities.description: `LichtFeld-Studio plugin create <name>` (package + .venv + VS Code config under ~/.lichtfeld/plugins/), `plugin check <name>` (validate manifest/structure), `plugin list` (installed plugins).
capabilities.side_effects: writes files under ~/.lichtfeld/plugins; creates uv venv

capabilities.label: Local MCP HTTP endpoint
capabilities.description: The GUI application starts an MCP server with resources enabled on http://127.0.0.1:45677/mcp (Streamable HTTP). `scripts/lichtfeld_mcp_bridge.py` (wired by .mcp.json) launches the app and proxies stdio MCP to it; LICHTFELD_MCP_ENDPOINT overrides the URL. Initialize, then tools/list and resources/list.

capabilities.label: MCP discovery resources (runtime/ui/scene/selection/history)
capabilities.description: Read-only URIs: lichtfeld://runtime/catalog (job ids, event types), runtime/state, runtime/jobs/<id>, runtime/events/<type>, ui/state, ui/tools, ui/menus, ui/panels, operators/registry, operators/modal_state, scene/state, scene/nodes, scene/selected_nodes, selection/current, history/state, history/stack, gaussians/stats, training/loss_curve. Agents read these before choosing tools.

capabilities.label: scene.load_dataset / load_checkpoint / load_ply
capabilities.description: MCP tools that import a COLMAP dataset (job import.dataset), resume a training checkpoint, or add a Gaussian PLY as a scene node. Long-running; pair with runtime.job.wait.
capabilities.side_effects: loads GPU memory; replaces current scene

capabilities.label: Scene graph inspection and edits
capabilities.description: scene.list_nodes, scene.get_selected_nodes (observe) plus scene.delete_node, scene.save_checkpoint and node operations surfaced through operator.invoke (rename, reparent, duplicate, visibility, lock, groups, crop boxes/ellipsoids, merge to single PLY).

capabilities.label: scene.export_* (ply, sog, spz, html, usd, usdz_nurec, rad, colmap)
capabilities.description: Synchronous exports of the current scene: scene.export_ply, export_sog (SuperSplat), export_spz (Niantic), export_html (standalone web viewer), export_usd / export_usdz_nurec (OpenUSD / NuRec), export_rad, export_colmap (sparse cameras). scene.export_status reports idle; scene.export_cancel cannot stop a running export.

capabilities.label: training.start / get_state / get_loss_history / list_operations / ask_advisor
capabilities.description: Start training on the loaded dataset (job training.main), read current iteration/loss state, fetch loss history, list available training operations, and ask the built-in training advisor for parameter suggestions. Pause/resume/stop go through runtime.job.control on training.main.

capabilities.label: runtime.job.* and runtime.events.* tracking
capabilities.description: runtime.job.list / describe / wait / control over normalised job ids (training.main, editor.python, import.dataset, export.scene, export.video, operator.modal) and runtime.events.tail / clear for event streams (training.progress, scene.changed, selection.changed, export.completed ...). The sanctioned alternative to polling.

capabilities.label: Screen-space and attribute Gaussian selection
capabilities.description: selection.rect, click, brush, lasso, polygon, ring, stroke, by_description (text), by_text, by_color, by_opacity, by_scale, grow, shrink, invert, clear, mask, preview, histogram and selection.get. Selections are the operand for gaussians.write, transform.* and operators.

capabilities.label: gaussians.read / gaussians.write raw tensors
capabilities.description: Read positions, scales, rotations, opacities and SH colors of the (selected) Gaussians as tensors, and write modified tensors back into the live model with undo history.

capabilities.label: transform.get / set / translate / rotate / scale
capabilities.description: Inspect and edit the transform of a scene node or selection, mirroring the native gizmos; edits are recorded in the shared history.

capabilities.label: Undo/redo history and transactions
capabilities.description: history.list / get (observe), history.undo / redo / jump / shrink, and history.begin_transaction / commit_transaction / rollback_transaction to group multiple mutations into one undoable step.

capabilities.label: Drive GUI tools, menus, panels and operators
capabilities.description: ui.tool.list / describe / invoke / set_submode / clear_active, ui.menu.list / describe / invoke, ui.panel.list / describe / update, ui.operator.activate / clear_active, and operator.list / describe / invoke / cancel_modal (modal flows surface via operator.modal job and operators/modal_state). Never guess ids; read the registry resources first.
capabilities.side_effects: arbitrary GUI actions incl. destructive operators (check `destructive` metadata)

capabilities.label: camera.* view control and render.* captures
capabilities.description: camera.get / set_view / reset / list / go_to_dataset_camera position the viewport; render.capture / capture_window / frame / settings.get / settings.set produce image or alpha captures of the current view for QA and reports.

capabilities.label: Camera path sequencer and video export
capabilities.description: sequencer.get / add_keyframe / update_keyframe / delete_keyframe / set_easing / play / pause / stop / set_playback_speed / save_path / load_path build a keyframed camera timeline; export.video (job export.video) renders it to a movie.

capabilities.label: Embedded Python console over MCP
capabilities.description: editor.set_code / get_code / run / is_running / wait / interrupt / get_output execute arbitrary Python inside the app's interpreter (job editor.python) with the `lichtfeld` module available. Full-power escape hatch; treat as remote code execution.
capabilities.side_effects: arbitrary code execution inside the workstation

capabilities.label: Embedded `lichtfeld` Python API
capabilities.description: `import lichtfeld as lf`: lf.ui.Panel (immediate/mixed/hybrid RML panels), Operator, Event, typed Properties, ToolDef/ToolRegistry, native transform gizmos, Signals, Capabilities (CapabilityRegistry/Broker, SceneContext, ViewContext), lf.plugins manager, lf.log, and a Layout API of widgets. Documented in docs/plugins/api-reference.md; version gated by lf.PLUGIN_API_VERSION.
capabilities.side_effects: extends and mutates the running app

capabilities.label: Plugin lifecycle management (lf.plugins)
capabilities.description: lf.plugins.discover / load / reload / unload / load_all / start_watcher / stop_watcher / install('owner/repo') / update / search / install_from_registry / check_updates / get_state / get_error / get_traceback / create. Plugins are pyproject packages under ~/.lichtfeld/plugins with a [tool.lichtfeld] manifest and isolated uv venvs.
capabilities.side_effects: installs third-party code from GitHub/registry; creates venvs

capabilities.label: Plugin manifest contract ([tool.lichtfeld])
capabilities.description: pyproject.toml must declare hot_reload, plugin_api (e.g. ">=1,<2"), lichtfeld_version (">=0.4.2") and required_features; [project].dependencies are installed per plugin. Legacy min/max_lichtfeld_version fields are rejected. Panels may ship sibling .rml/.rcss/.theme.rcss templates.

capabilities.label: Supported export formats
capabilities.description: PLY (standard 3DGS), SOG (SuperSplat), SPZ (Niantic), HTML standalone viewer, USD/USDA/USDC (OpenUSD), USDZ NuRec, RAD (random access), COLMAP sparse cameras. Format ids appear in src as export.format.*.

capabilities.label: Docker build/run for Linux
capabilities.description: docker/Dockerfile (CUDA_VERSION arg), docker-compose.yml (host network, gpus all, X11 and ~/.lichtfeld mounts) and run_docker.sh build a development image with GUI passthrough; not a headless service image.
capabilities.side_effects: builds image; privileged container with host network

metadata.framework: CMake + vcpkg, embedded Python, RmlUi, MCP over HTTP

relations.description: Inferred from formats, not from code: LichtFeld loads standard 3DGS PLY (scene.load_ply / -v) and GGGS ships ply2gs.py to produce exactly that; no explicit reference between the repositories.
Inferred from formats, not from code: Matrix-3D emits generated_3dgs_opt.ply Gaussian scenes that LichtFeld can open, inspect and re-export; neither repository references the other.

contracts.name: MCP endpoint
contracts.summary: Streamable HTTP MCP on 127.0.0.1:45677/mcp with resources + tools

contracts.name: Export formats
contracts.summary: ply, sog, spz, html, usd/usda/usdc, usdz_nurec, rad, colmap

resources.name: docs site
resources.description: Docusaurus docs: plugin system, API reference, MCP guide and recipes

environment.name: LICHTFELD_MCP_ENDPOINT
environment.purpose: URL of the MCP bridge the studio is driven through; overrides the default loopback endpoint.

environment.name: LICHTFELD_MCP_START_TIMEOUT_S
environment.purpose: How long the bridge waits for the studio process to come up before reporting it did not start.

environment.name: LICHTFELD_MCP_BRIDGE_LOG
environment.purpose: Path the bridge writes its own log to.

environment.name: LICHTFELD_MCP_BRIDGE_LOCK
environment.purpose: Lock-file path that keeps two bridges from driving one studio process.

reference.spatial: Scene-local coordinates of loaded splats/COLMAP cameras; no GIS georeferencing.
reference.temporal: Training iterations, undo history stack and sequencer timeline; no calendar time.
open_questions: MCP server binds localhost only; how does the control plane reach it from another host (bridge script per workstation, or an SSH tunnel)?
The MCP surface has no authentication and editor.run is arbitrary code execution; the universe should gate all lichtfeld tools behind operator approval as declared here.
Which ecosystem exports (USD to bim-state-transformer-engine? HTML viewer to notations-dock?) are intended is not evidenced in any repository yet.

corpus.holding: Nothing canonical. It loads COLMAP datasets and checkpoints from disk, edits them in a session and exports.

COR-008.note: Undo history and the sequencer timeline live only in the session; there is no durable record of what a human changed.

COR-009.note: It consumes datasets and checkpoints from disk and hands exports back; it writes into no other system's state.

COR-010.note: Must never be the canonical store of scene state.
